text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! I thought I was gonna shock
the world
with a record time!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm amazing! A genius—the
fastest in the
world! But well...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm on the scoreboard at least. That'll do
for
today.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Did you see me, Тренер?! I was soaring
with all
my might!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса's expectations and ideals
far
exceed anyone else's. Sometimes,
they feel as
infinite as the sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And she did excellent today. In fact, if
her
stamina can withstand a race like
that...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: How are you feeling, El? Tired?

text_block_list.text: Qué? Tired? I'm totally fine.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm tough as nails and always ready
'cause of all
the spicy food I eat!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her feet are steady. She really might
have what it
takes to make her dream
come true.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She once mentioned her desire to
compete with
her rivals in her classic
year. At least once, I want
that dream to
come true.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer, what race should we
shoot for
next? I'm guessing something
in the fall?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If we go for the fall, I can run with the
seniors...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...Qué? Um, Trainer... Did I hear you
right?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I thought I just heard you say the
Derby...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: That's right! Let's go to the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.text:
I tell her again with more vigor. It'll be a
difficult
race, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby... The Derby... But
that's like
right after this!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This is incredible! I thought I had to
choose
between the Derby and the NHK
Mile Cup...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Is it really okay, Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: If you're feeling up to it.

text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm feelin' better than ever
after
hearing this!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Bueno! Bueno! Bueno, bueno, buenooo!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I can run in the Japanese Derby...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: With all my beloved friends!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
"Эль Кондор Паса Hits the Derby!" The
news
spreads quickly throughout Tracen
Academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Grass... did you hear the news?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I had no idea either. I guess El talked
with her
trainer and decided on impulse.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: El!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Whaaam!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: El! We need to talk!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ah, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I... decided to go to the Derby all of a
sudden!
Um...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Is that okay with you?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yaaay!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Qué?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to run with you in the
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Let's have an awesome race! You and
me!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yeah! You know it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Turns out they all wanted this race to
happen. El
Condor Pasa no longer has a
reason to feel like
she's intruding.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All I can do is hope they have an
amazing
race—one where they battle it
out with
everything they've got... on the
biggest stage of
the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
